item.title: Harish Rao accuses CM of threat politics
item.description: BRSLP deputy leader Harish Rao on Wednesday launched a scathing attack on Revanth Reddy, questioning whether he was functioning as a Chief Minister or a street thug. Responding to comments made by the Chief Minister during a public meeting in Miryalaguda, Rao condemned the language used against the public and opposition leaders. item.title: Google Teases Pixel 10a Ahead of Early Launch, Likely to Keep Affordable Pricing
item.description: Google’s upcoming Pixel 10a blends familiar design, early launch timing, and reliable hardware upgrades while keeping its budget-friendly appeal intact.

item.description: The Hyderabad Cyber Crime Police arrested a 42-year-old man from New Delhi involved in a digital arrest fraud amounting to Rs 1.07 crore.Police arrested Gurdeep Singh alias Lucky Narang. item.title: Revive employment guarantee, protect the poor’
item.description: Hyderabad: BC State Finance Corporation Chairman Nuti Srikanth Goud on Friday demanded the revival and expansion of the Mahatma Gandhi Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme, asserting that the Congress party would not tolerate any attempt to weaken or discard it. item.title: Prez offers prayers at Puri temple
item.description: President Droupadi Murmu performed the ‘pinda daan’ ritual at the revered ‘Sweta Gan-ga’ tank in Puri on Wednesday morning and then visited the Jagannath temple. item.description: India hit a peak of over 2 million barrels per day significances from Russia. That position dipped to about 1.3 million barrels per day in December and is anticipated to remain flat this month.

item.title: Top Maoist surrenders in Malkangiri
item.description: A hardcore CPI(Maoist) cadre on Wednesday surrendered before the Malkangiri Police.
